data.title: Saudi Ambassador Presents Credentials as Non-Resident Ambassador to President of North Macedonia
data.content:
Skopje, November 21, 2026, SPA -- Saudi Ambassador to the Republic of Albania Turki Al-Madi has presented his credentials as non-resident ambassador extraordinary and plenipotentiary to the Republic of North Macedonia to President Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova.
    During the ceremony, Ambassador Al-Madi conveyed the greetings of Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud and His Royal Highness Prince Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, Crown Prince and Prime Minister, along with their wishes for further progress and prosperity for the government and people of North Macedonia.
    President Siljanovska-Davkova expressed her gratitude and appreciation to the Kingdom's leadership, government, and people, affirming North Macedonia's aspiration to strengthen bilateral cooperation across all fields.
    -- SPA
16:12 Local Time 13:12 GMT
